name: People Who Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that sin originates from the subtle deception introduced by the serpent, leading humanity into disobedience as seen in Genesis 3:1. Believers are called to forgive others as God forgives their trespasses (Mark 11:25; Luke 17:3), highlighting the importance of repentance and conversion for the blotting out of sins (Acts 3:19). Furthermore, James 4:17 emphasizes that knowingly failing to do good is itself sin, underscoring personal responsibility in living according to God's will.
